letter:
Hi Ana,

I wanted to share a few changes that would make my work easier and more effective. Most of these cost little or nothing; I suggest we try them for four weeks and then review how it went.

1. I’d like to post my standup update in writing in the team thread before 10:00 instead of speaking in the call — our Engineering Handbook already allows async standups.
2. I’d like captions turned on in our team meetings and the transcript or notes shared afterwards (meet captions are free; transcription is about $0.22/hour if we use a service).
3. I’d like to receive the agenda and the tickets for planning and refinement the day before — the Engineering Handbook asks for agenda posted the day before.
4. I’d like the tickets assigned to me to include written acceptance criteria before I start — the Engineering Handbook includes acceptance criteria in the Definition of Done.
5. I’d like two working days instead of one to do and respond to code reviews.

Thanks for considering these. I’m happy to discuss any of them and try the set for four weeks, then regroup.

Andrei
disclaimer: Informational, not legal advice. OnRamp does not store your choices or this letter.
